blocks.text: MADRID, Spain — Veteran Hollywood director Woody Allen is shooting his latest film on the streets of Madrid as the Spanish capital seeks to burnish its status as a global cinema hub. The US director-screenwriter-actor, now largely ostracised in his home country by scandals, began the shooting for his 51st film earlier this month in the city. Dozens of curious onlookers gathered on Wednesday as the crew shut roads in bustling central Madrid, where AFP saw the 90-year-old oversee the set.
